1.caption: Table 1: Quarterly revenue and cost by branch, FY2026 (PKR '000)
1.challenge: ~150 rows over several pages; header repeats on each page; region group rows span all columns; branch name/code only on the first of four rows (implicit row-span); subtotal rows; accounting-style negatives in parentheses; watermark text drawn over the table.

0.caption: Table 0: Headline figures (unaudited)
0.challenge: Small summary table whose revenue figure CONFLICTS with Table 1 grand total; the errata page gives the correct value.

2.caption: Table 2: Shipment log, sample of 95 consignments
2.challenge: Multi-page table whose header is NOT repeated on continuation pages; Unicode status symbols; long wrapped text in the last column; random row heights.

3.caption: Table 3: Revenue and cost by region and half-year (PKR '000)
3.challenge: Three-level column header (year > half > measure) with column spans; zone column uses vertical row spans; on a landscape page; referenced by Tables 8 and the errata.

4.caption: Table 4: Unit rates and indices
4.challenge: No borders or shading at all (whitespace-only columns); decimal-aligned numbers; European number format mixed with Pakistani/US format; unicode minus signs; 'n/a' and dash for missing values. Decimal alignment makes the PDF store each number as two separate text fragments (e.g. '3' and '.602,75').

5.caption: Table 5: Service level commitments
5.challenge: Cells contain bullet lists, multi-sentence paragraphs and a table nested inside a cell.

6.caption: Table 6: Fleet inventory at 30 June 2026
6.challenge: Twelve-column table drawn rotated 90 degrees on a portrait page; text runs bottom-to-top.

7.caption: Table 7a / 7b: Top 5 customers / Top 5 suppliers
7.challenge: Two separate tables placed side by side with no gap row; the detector may merge them into one 6-column table and mix customers with suppliers.

8.caption: Table 8: Headcount at year end
8.challenge: Footnote markers (a, b, c, *, †) inside header and body cells with footnotes printed below the table; a cell that refers to another table.

9.caption: Table 9: Diesel consumption by depot, litres (July–December)
9.challenge: A table too wide for the page, split horizontally: July–December on one page, January–June on the next page with only row numbers repeated (no depot names). Rows must be re-joined by '#'.

10.caption: Table 10: Approval register, scanned from the signed paper copy
10.challenge: Table exists only as a low-quality, slightly rotated JPEG image: needs OCR plus table-structure recognition on noisy pixels.

11.caption: Table 11: Budget versus actual, FY2026 (PKR '000)
11.challenge: Empty cells, 'nil', em dashes, 'n/a', accounting negatives, a percentage column with unicode minus; one row pulls its value from Table 1.

12.caption: Table 12: Mandatory training completion by employee
12.challenge: Column headers are vertical (rotated) text; no grid lines, only zebra shading; cells hold symbols and partial percentages.

13.caption: Table 13: Monthly RAG status by project
13.challenge: Status is encoded ONLY by cell colour (no text in cells); meaning is in a legend below. Text extraction sees an empty grid.

14.caption: Table 14: Vendor registration (form)
14.challenge: A key-value FORM laid out as a grid: two key/value pairs per row. Treating it as a normal table with a header row gives wrong column semantics; checkboxes as unicode symbols.

15.caption: Table 15: Consignments handled per depot per day
15.challenge: 14 columns × 31 rows in 5.5 pt font with faint hairline grid; depot names are abbreviations explained nowhere in the table.

16a.caption: Table 16a: Karachi Port depot bays
16a.challenge: Two tables with identical columns placed directly after each other, separated only by a one-line caption; they may be merged into one table and lose which depot each row belongs to.

17.caption: Table 17: Branch managers (caption printed BELOW the table)
17.challenge: Mixed English and Urdu (right-to-left) columns; caption placed below the table instead of above.

18.caption: Table 18: Customer KPIs (inside a two-column text layout)
18.challenge: Small table embedded in the first column of a two-column page; reading order must not mix the table with the neighbouring column's text.

Errata.caption: Errata
Errata.challenge: Prose corrections that override table values printed earlier in the document.
